findings.title: Flames are drawn on invisible pawns
findings.detail: Vanilla swaps every render-node material for an invisible one when parms.flags has PawnRenderFlags.Invisible (outside portraits). PostDraw in PawnRenderNodeWorker_TitanFlames draws its own materials and never checks that flag, so a psychically invisible titan still shows its flames. In PostDraw (Source/TitanFlames.cs:128), return early when parms.flags.FlagSet(PawnRenderFlags.Invisible), or pass each material through InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat.

findings.title: Flame draw call ignores parms.DrawNow
findings.detail: PawnRenderTree.Draw uses GenDraw.DrawMeshNowOrLater(mesh, matrix, mat, parms.DrawNow). TitanFlames.cs:158 always calls Graphics.DrawMesh, which queues for the world camera. PawnRenderer sets Cache|DrawNow on one path, and the guard at TitanFlames.cs:121 only skips Portrait and Statue. Use GenDraw.DrawMeshNowOrLater(MeshPool.plane10, trs, mat, parms.DrawNow), or also return when parms.flags has Cache. I did not confirm that path runs without the Portrait flag.

findings.title: Mathf.Abs(int) can throw on int.MinValue
findings.detail: Mathf.Abs(frameIndex ^ seed) throws OverflowException if the XOR is exactly int.MinValue. It is very unlikely, but `(frameIndex ^ seed) & 0x7fffffff` removes the risk.

findings.title: Flame node's mesh size ignores female and alternate body graphics
findings.detail: PawnRenderNode_TitanFlames.MeshSetFor reads CurKindLifeStage.bodyGraphicData only. The overlay node's SourceGraphic also handles femaleGraphicData and alternate graphics, so the two can disagree on creatures whose variants differ in drawSize.

findings.title: scaleEffectersWithBodySize defaults on and the first trait listing an effecter decides
findings.detail: Existing content that uses effecters will now spread and grow with sqrt(body size) without opting in. EffecterScaled checks all traits, including ones whose visuals aren't active, and returns the first match, so two traits sharing an effecter with different flags resolve by trait order.
